sources.entry: Flinto - Quickly create interactive prototypes of mobile, desktop, or web apps.

summary.name: Flinto
summary.one_liner: Flinto is a Mac app for creating interactive and animated prototypes of mobile, desktop, or web app designs.
use_cases: prototype mobile app screens with transitions
design micro-interactions for buttons and switches
preview app designs on an iPhone in real time
import Sketch or Figma designs and make them clickable
record and export animated prototype videos
summary.what_it_does: Flinto is a Mac app for building interactive, animated prototypes of app designs. Its Transition Designer lets users place screens and animate transitions between them without timelines or programming, and its Behavior Designer adds micro-interactions and scroll-based animations within screens. It can import designs from Sketch and Figma, including vector shapes and editable text, and offers vector drawing tools for simple mockups. Prototypes can be previewed in real time on a WiFi-connected iOS device and recordings can be exported as video or GIF.
notable: Transition Designer and Behavior Designer for animations without programming
Real-time preview on iOS device via free viewer app
Imports from Sketch and Figma with vector shapes and editable text
caveats: Requires macOS 10.14 or newer and iOS 12.0 or newer
Pricing is not stated on the page
